text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Neither my running... nor my feelings 
reached them...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand that not everything goes 
the way we want."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...However, when the story doesn't unfold 
the way I envisioned it, it's still 
frustrating after all—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—No matter what I do, all I can think 
about are regrets...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's true, isn't it... What matters is 
how things unfold after a loss...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I still have a chance too... In that case—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer... Next time, I promise I will 
win!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's true... whether I keep moving 
forward or throw in the towel is entirely 
up to me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Because this is... my story, our story...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um...! I won't complain anymore. Please, 
give me tougher training!
